scope: All current canonical catalogue/resource/hardware pages; aliases, homepage/editorial/portfolio and utility routes are excluded.

policy.generation: Built-in image_gen for construction/material/process jobs only; one independent raster per canonical URL.
policy.hardware: Only real photos of verified models from the three approved supplier catalogs. Generated hardware illustrations are forbidden.
policy.existingExactRule: None accepted automatically. Existing full photo must be visually checked against every visible requirement and reserved for only one URL.
policy.clearGlass: Clear colourless glass must stay neutral Crystal Vision; intentional bronze/grey only when specified.
policy.review: Pending does not mean technically verified. Confirm physical geometry and exact visible properties before accepting. Do not invent dimensions or a user drawing.

output.sourceRaster: Keep original generated raster or verified supplier photograph with provenance.
